notes_for_editor: Conflicts left stated in text: cost $180,000 (NRHP) vs $80,000 appropriation (LighthouseFriends); who set the boy's leg in 1927 (Bulletin says Walters, LF says Hermann); date the single dwelling was razed (1930s alterations per NRHP, 1940 per LF); tower height (State Parks 56 ft; NRHP 42 ft floor to lantern floor, different measure); prism count (LF 640, State Parks brochure 392) left out; year of Coast Guard to State Parks transfer not stated because OCVA and the State Parks brochure appear to differ. The 1891 report page printed number unconfirmed (scan 232); fiscal-year label of the 1891-92 volume entry assumed 1891. LighthouseFriends was used for facts only and paraphrased; its anecdote about assistant Thomas E. Alexander was left out. Newspaper search (Chronicling America, Oregon, 1890-1925) found only scenic mentions and one unrelated 1906 item; none used. Roster: Donald Redfearn 'at least 1960' and R.G. Readfearn (USCG 1961-62) may be one person, not stated by any source. Heceta House ghost folklore deliberately omitted.
